'''Showdown: Four Lights''' is the 52nd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on December 8, 2023. The set consists of 37 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*3 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Cardassian)
*2 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*5 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*2 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*20 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (13 Cardassian, and 11 Federation)
*2 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian and 1 Federation)

''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*37 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
